description: This Java class implements a command strategy for applying a loan in the Fineract system. It handles batch requests to apply loans using the LoansApiResource, capturing responses and errors, and returning a BatchResponse object.

classes.name: ApplyLoanCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements CommandStrategy to process batch loan application requests by calling LoansApiResource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the loan application process for a batch request, sets up the response, and returns a BatchResponse with status and body.
